shared_elements: carved stone surface with low-relief/incised imagery
anthropomorphic figure occupying the full height of the field
horizontal banded divisions across the body of the composition
hand/arm holding or displaying an object
panel of small repeated marks (glyph-like or textured field)
justification: Both present a single tall anthropomorphic figure filling the vertical field, with a disc-like motif on the torso, banded divisions and a patch of small repeated glyph-like marks in the upper area. But A is a bulky three-dimensional boulder-like monolith carved in worn, rounded, minimally detailed relief and seen frontally, whereas B is a flat slab covered in fine, crisp, densely incised linear detail (feathering, plant rosettes, textiles) with a figure in profile — the manner of rendering and the density of ornament are almost opposite.
